title: Blue Paradise Rincón Beachfront Luxury Escape
description: Discover Paraíso Azul, a second-level beachfront luxury apartment located within the serene Sol y Playa gated community. This two-bedroom, two-bathroom retreat is fully remodeled with a brand-new kitchen, gorgeous bathrooms, and fully air-conditioned interiors. Enjoy breathtaking ocean views, direct access to Los Almendros Beach—the best sandy, bather’s beach in Rincón—and unforgettable sunsets. With all the amenities you need, Paraíso Azul is your perfect coastal luxury getaway!The spaceParaíso Azul is a sophisticated beachfront escape designed for guests who appreciate comfort, design, and tranquility. Located directly in front of Los Almendros Beach, one of Rincón’s most prized stretches of sand, this one-level luxury apartment offers breathtaking beach and sunset views throughout the space, while remaining just minutes from Rincón’s town center, dining, and nightlife—yet perfectly tucked away in a serene and peaceful setting.Designed specifically for adults seeking a relaxed and elevated experience, Paraíso Azul welcomes accompanying teenagers aged 13 and older. Children under 13 are not permitted.This fully remodeled, one-story apartment features 2 beautifully appointed bedrooms and 2 designer bathrooms, all curated by a professional design expert to deliver a high-end, hotel-level experience with the warmth of a private home. Every space is fully air-conditioned, ensuring comfort throughout your stay.The state-of-the-art modern kitchen is equipped with premium, high-end appliances and all the amenities needed to prepare anything from a casual breakfast to a sunset dinner. The open living and dining areas flow seamlessly toward expansive views of the ocean, creating an inviting atmosphere that blends indoor comfort with the beauty of the outdoors.Both bedrooms feature premium beds, luxury linens, plush pillows, and thoughtful details designed for deep rest and relaxation. The bathrooms are equally impressive, showcasing gorgeous designer finishes and stocked with luxury toiletries to elevate your stay.Step outside and take in unobstructed views of Los Almendros Beach, known for its soft sands, calm waters, and some of the most stunning sunsets in Rincón. Whether you’re enjoying morning coffee, an afternoon breeze, or golden-hour cocktails, Paraíso Azul places the ocean at the center of your experience.Additional amenities include: • One assigned private parking space • High-speed Wi-Fi • TV’s with cable and streaming services in the living room and in both bedrooms • Fully equipped private laundry room with washer and dryer for guest use • Professionally curated décor throughoutEvery detail of Paraíso Azul has been intentionally designed to offer an elevated beachfront experience—where luxury feels effortless, comfort is paramount, and the rhythm of the ocean sets the tone for your stay.Unwind, recharge, and experience the very best of Rincón from Paraíso Azul—your home away from home!Guest accessWe want you to enjoy your stay to the fullest, and we’re delighted to let you know that the entire apartment is exclusively yours, ensuring a comfortable, private, and relaxing experience.Paraíso Azul is an apartment within the Sol y Playa gated community, located in the Córcega ward of Rincón.The apartment is situated on the second level of the center tower, positioned directly in front of the ocean, and is accessed via a single, short flight of stairs. While there is no elevator, the access is easy and allows you to arrive effortlessly into your private beachfront retreat.Enjoy your time at Paraíso Azul and savor every moment of your elevated beachfront escape in Rincón.Other things to noteA Friendly Note on Utilities:Just a heads-up! The Sol y Playa complex does have a power generator that lights up all communal areas, but it does not power the apartment itself. In the event of a power loss, guests will need to be flexible and open windows and doors for ventilation until power is restored.In case of a power outage, each bedroom is equipped with battery-powered lanterns for illumination.Please note that any outages of power or water are beyond the control of the owners and managers of the property, as they pertain to the local authorities of power and water. Although they are not common in the area, we’re sharing this information so you know what to expect and can have a comfortable stay with us.

description: We are the only vacation rental on beautiful Pools Beach.. Our property includes two apartments that can be rented independently or together as a guesthouse. description: Welcome to Sunset Horizon Chalet — your peaceful, breezy beach escape just steps from one of Rincón’s best swimming beaches. Tucked in a friendly, walkable beach community, this rustic-chic wooden chalet is full of charm, natural light, and tropical vibes.The home offers 3 comfortable bedrooms (each with A/C), 2 full baths, & convenient half bath just off the main floor and full kitchen with stove top (no oven).
